title: Organization settings
description: Billing details, reservation and payment rules, policies, sales channels and tax mapping. Every save creates a new version.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view organization settings.
sections.company_desc: Legal details printed on contracts and invoices.
sections.reservation_desc: All four settings are required before online sales can be published.
sections.payment_desc: Prepayment taken at booking and the full payment option.
sections.late_return_desc: Grace period and the extra hour fee charged after it.
sections.policies_desc: Texts shown to customers in reservations and contracts.
sections.tax_desc: No legal rate is built in; enter the rate that applies to your organization.
sections.invoice_items_desc: Accounting code and optional VAT rate of each line type for the e-invoice integration.
fields.tax_number_hint: 10-digit VKN, or 11-digit TCKN for sole proprietors.
fields.staff_review_window_hint: Time staff have to answer a reservation that needs approval.
fields.payment_hold_hint: The vehicle is held for payment this long.
fields.quote_validity_hint: How long a price quote stays valid.
fields.full_payment_allowed_hint: Customers may pay the full amount when booking.
fields.extra_hour_fee_hint: Leave empty to charge no extra hour fee.
fields.default_vat_rate_hint: Used for invoice lines without their own rate.
channels.widget_hint: Booking form embedded on other sites.
channels.api_hint: Bookings from integration partners through the API.
channels.branch_hint: Bookings created by staff at a branch office.
readiness.ready_description: The reservation settings online sales need are complete.
readiness.not_ready_title: Online sales cannot be published yet
conflict.title: Someone else changed the settings
conflict.description: A new version was saved while you were editing. Load the latest version and apply your changes again.
versions.load_failed: Version history could not be loaded.
versions.empty_description: Version 1 is created the first time you save the settings.
diff.title: Version {{older}} → {{newer}}
diff.description: Changed fields; stored versions never change.
validation.tax_number: Enter a valid VKN (10 digits) or TCKN (11 digits).
validation.percent: Enter a rate between 0 and 100 (at most 2 decimals).
validation.money: Enter a valid amount (at most 2 decimals).
validation.prepayment_amount: Enter a prepayment amount above zero.
validation.prepayment_percent: Enter a rate above 0 and at most 100.
profile.title: Organization profile
profile.name: Organization name
profile.name_hint: Shown in the panel and in invitations. The address (/t/{{slug}}) does not change.
profile.logo_hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG; at most 2 MB.
profile.logo_too_large: The logo can be at most 2 MB.
profile.logo_remove_description: An icon is shown in the sidebar and the organization switcher instead.
profile.validation.name_too_long: Name can be at most 255 characters.
